discovery.source_kind: Exact Wi-Fi 6 GB / 128 GB Philippine SKU, product features and specifications
discovery.result: Official Philippine page identifies Gray Wi-Fi SKU SM-X510NZAAXTC and lists its 6 GB RAM, 128 GB storage, dimensions, display, cameras, Wi-Fi, USB, battery, weight and sensors.

discovery.source_kind: Exact 5G 6 GB / 128 GB Philippine SKU, product features and specifications
discovery.result: Official Philippine page identifies Gray 5G SKU SM-X516BZAA XTC and lists its 6 GB RAM, 128 GB storage, cellular bands, dimensions, display, cameras, Wi-Fi, USB, battery, weight and sensors.

discovery.source_kind: Dated Philippine launch and availability of the Galaxy Tab S9 FE series
discovery.result: Samsung Philippines announced local availability beginning October 20, 2023, and stated the series started at PHP 26,990. The launch statement is series-level; exact SKU pricing comes from Samsung's own offer listing.

discovery.source_kind: Dated official Philippine cash price for exact 6 GB / 128 GB Wi-Fi and 5G configurations
discovery.result: Samsung Philippines' 2023 campaign table lists PHP 26,990 for the Galaxy Tab S9 FE Wi-Fi 6 GB + 128 GB and PHP 31,990 for the 5G 6 GB + 128 GB. Campaign page does not expose an exact publication day.

discovery.source_kind: Expired 2025 Philippine network-level SRP and promotional price observations
discovery.result: Samsung listed Wi-Fi SRP PHP 28,990 / offer PHP 26,990 and 5G SRP PHP 33,990 / offer PHP 31,990, with the offer period July 11–September 30, 2025. This table does not identify RAM/storage, so these observations are model/network-level only and are not attached to a configuration.

discovery.source_kind: Global announcement and selected-market general availability date
discovery.result: Samsung announced the FE series on October 4, 2023 and said the Tab S9 FE series would be available in selected markets starting October 5, 2023. The latter is a global selected-market date, not a Philippine release date.

discovery.source_kind: Exynos 1380 process node, CPU architecture and GPU specifications
discovery.result: Samsung lists 5 nm process, four Cortex-A78 cores at 2.4 GHz, four Cortex-A55 cores at 2.0 GHz and Mali-G68 graphics with five cores. The Tab S9 FE manufacturer pages identify Exynos 1380.

discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer model-family cross-check for launch OS, stereo speakers, memory options and 45 W charging
discovery.result: Samsung lists Android 13, 6/128 and 8/256 memory options, two FE cameras, 8,000 mAh battery, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3 and wired charging requiring a separately sold 45 W wall charger. US carrier and availability notes are not treated as Philippine evidence.

discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer model-family comparison for SM-X510N / SM-X516B, charging and wireless-charging capability
discovery.result: Samsung's comparison identifies SM-X510N as Wi-Fi and SM-X516B as cellular; it lists 45 W Super Fast Charging and states inductive charging is unsupported. Regional source is used only for shared model-family hardware, not local sale or price.

discovery.source_kind: Secondary specification cross-check for display protection, RAM/storage type, charging and battery chemistry
discovery.result: NanoReview lists Corning Gorilla Glass 3, LPDDR4X, UFS 2.2, 45 W charging, no wireless charging and Li-Ion chemistry. These are secondary claims; the Li-Ion battery chemistry conflicts with Kimovil and is withheld.

Kimovil lists 6/128 Wi-Fi, 8/256 Wi-Fi, 6/128 5G and 8/256 5G variants and reports Li-Polymer battery chemistry. Its battery chemistry conflicts with NanoReview; global configuration listings do not establish Philippine sales.
Direct access returned HTTP 402 Payment Required. No protection was bypassed and no specification values were copied from this page.

discovery.source_kind: Exact-model product-image match and source page reviewed; asset not reused
discovery.result: Samsung product imagery depicts the Galaxy Tab S9 FE, but the page does not grant reuse permission for the public catalog.

Samsung Mobile Press terms identify images as Samsung or licensor property and limit copying/downloading to personal, informational and non-commercial use. The terms do not authorize reuse in this public product catalog.

discovery.source_kind: Search for reusable exact-model product photography
discovery.result: The reviewed category contains scene photographs taken with a Galaxy Tab S9 FE, not product photographs of the device. No suitable exact-model openly licensed product image was found.
